list_emails: list emails in the INBOX folder with pagination using offset and limit parameters
send_email: send an email to recipients with optional CC addresses and file attachments from the cloud drive
search_emails: search emails by query string across sender, recipients, subject, and content fields in a folder
reply_to_email: reply to an existing email with automatic Re: subject prefix and parent chain resolution
forward_email: forward an existing email to new recipients with FWD: subject prefix and preserved attachments
